description: disp-formula whose <mml:math>/<tex-math> are wrapped in <alternatives> (the JATS-recommended pattern for offering both a MathML and a TeX rendering of the same formula): MathML is raw-preserved as math:source/math:format="mathml" (not concatenated with the TeX text), and the sibling <tex-math> alternative is raw-preserved verbatim under jats:alternatives-raw rather than dropped
